title: Forgot to bring books
simplified_paragraphs: A：喂？你在哪？你没带你的书！
A：我是你妈！我看见你的书在家。你忘了，是吗？
B：妈妈！对，我的书在家，今天不用带书。
A：好的，知道了。今天想吃什么？
traditional_paragraphs: A：喂？你在哪？你沒帶你的書！
A：我是你媽！我看見你的書在家。你忘了，是嗎？
B：媽媽！對，我的書在家，今天不用帶書。
A：好的，知道了。今天想吃什麼？
pinyin_paragraphs: A： wéi？ nǐ zài nǎ？ nǐ méi dài nǐ de shū！
B： shén me？ nǐ shì shéi？
A： wǒ shì nǐ mā！ wǒ kàn jiàn nǐ de shū zài jiā。 nǐ wàng le， shì ma？
B： mā ma！ duì， wǒ de shū zài jiā， jīn tiān bù yòng dài shū。
A： hǎo de， zhī dào le。 jīn tiān xiǎng chī shén me？
B： wǒ xiǎng chī mǐ fàn。
A： hǎo de， chī mǐ fàn。 zài jiàn。
english_paragraphs: A: Hello? Where are you? You didn't bring your books!
A: It's your mom! I can see your books at home. You forgot them, didn't you?
B: Mom! Yes, my books are at home. I don't need to bring them today.
A: Okay, got it. What do you want to eat today?
A: Okay, rice it is. Bye.
english_full:
A: Hello? Where are you? You didn't bring your books!

B: What? Who is this?

A: It's your mom! I can see your books at home. You forgot them, didn't you?

B: Mom! Yes, my books are at home. I don't need to bring them today.

A: Okay, got it. What do you want to eat today?

B: I want rice.

A: Okay, rice it is. Bye.

B: Bye!
